name: Publishable TS library (tsup + OIDC publish)
description: Turns a TS template into a publishable dual ESM/CJS npm package: a library entry (src/lib/index.ts) built by tsup into lib/, an exports map checked by attw in CI, a prepack build and prepublishOnly gate, MIT as the default license, and an OIDC publish workflow that runs the CI checks first.
